title: 1811 Prairie's stable stands two storeys, as in 1904
items: The coach house behind 1811 Prairie now rises two storeys. A Tribune advertisement of April 1904 offers the house with a '2 story stable', and the 1891 atlas draws a stable on the alley in the same place.
The house itself is unchanged: the 1891 atlas draws it about 27 m deep, as the 1911 map does, so the long brick range was already standing.
